Container.Name: cinefex-online
Container.Overview: The complete Cinefex magazine archive (1980-present), served as a static web app. Image rebuilds on every merge to main. Issues content is supplied at runtime via a bind mount on your share.
Container.Description: The web archive. Issues are read from your share; covers and fonts are baked into the image. Update the image by re-running the container (unraid pulls :latest on restart when configured).

Variable.Description: Container path the issues/ share is bind-mounted to. Don't change unless you also update the Volume mapping.
Internal port vite preview listens on. Must match the published port on the left side of the Port mapping.
Container timezone for log timestamps. Set to whatever you like.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Internal port vite preview listens on.

Config.Name: Issues Share
Config.Description: Path on the unraid host to your issues/ tree. Each issue should be a numbered subdirectory (1, 2, ..., N) with manifest.xml and *.html files.

Config.Name: Image Tag
Config.Description: Which tag to pull. :latest is rebuilt on every merge to main.
